name: autoclip
description: AutoClip｜The open-source OpusClip alternative — local-first AI clipping & MCP server, zero subscriptions. 一个链接，一键出片。开源 AI 视频剪辑桌面工具，将播客、访谈、课程等长视频自动剪成短视频，生成字幕、封面和发布文案，适配抖音、小红书、TikTok、Reels 与 YouTube Shorts。
one_liner: A free, offline app that takes one long video, like a podcast or lecture, and automatically turns it into several short, captioned clips ready for TikTok or Reels.
buyer: A podcaster or solo content creator who knows clipping long episodes into shorts grows their audience but doesn't have hours each week to do it by hand.
business_use_cases: A social media manager uses it to turn a client's weekly podcast into daily short clips, billing the client for the editing work it automates.
A content agency replaces a paid clipping subscription service with this self-hosted tool, pocketing the savings as margin.
A course creator repurposes long lecture recordings into short, discoverable clips that drive traffic back to the full paid course.

money_ideas.idea: A done-for-you clipping service for podcasters, billed per episode or monthly
One-off batch processing of a creator's back catalog into shorts

steal_this: Offer three local podcasters a free trial week turning one episode each into shorts, then convert the ones who see real view growth into paying monthly clients.
